_comment: Candidate indicators for the NYC VLR crosswalk. Each entry is a natural-language query run against search_indicators, scoped to the places listed. Add topics freely -- the probe is cheap and the point is to find out what is chartable BEFORE we design around it.

topics.label: Air quality (PM2.5)
topics.query: fine particulate matter air pollution PM2.5

topics.label: Inadequate housing
topics.query: population living in inadequate housing or slums

topics.label: Municipal solid waste
topics.query: municipal solid waste collection and recycling

topics.label: Renewable energy share
topics.query: renewable energy share of final energy consumption
